name: print-layout
title: PrintLayout
description: Printable document frame for invoices, reports and receipts: an A4 or Letter page (`size`) with margins (`margin`), header and footer slots and a `PageBreak` helper. On screen it is a paper sheet (bg-card / text-card-foreground, border, shadow-sm) on a muted backdrop in the current theme; `print:` variants drop the chrome (no backdrop, border, shadow or outer padding) and an `@page` rule sets paper size and margins (`pageRule`). The header and footer print once, at the top and end of the document. The consuming app should print with the light theme (ThemeProvider `defaultMode="light"`, or `setMode('light')` before `window.print()`); no print-only colours are defined.
author: gntik-ai
